title: PODZO - Transporter Proof-of-Delivery & Automated Invoicing Intelligence
heroHeadline: 98% Touchless Invoice Clearance - 14 Days to 4 Hours Cycle Time
basicIntro: Welcome to PODZO! I'll show you how we automate mining and freight logistics from siding weighment to SAP MIRO invoice posting.

cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for PODZO - Transporter Proof-of-Delivery & Automated Invoicing Intelligence. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: Paper Proof-of-Delivery Bottleneck: Physical bilties take 10-14 days to courier from remote siding gates to headquarters, delaying billing cycles and freezing carrier cash flow.
Weighbridge Variance & Transit Leakage: Discrepancies between origin siding tare/gross and destination customer weighments cause unrecovered transit shrinkage.
Manual Data Entry & Invoice Discrepancies: Accounts Payable re-keys paper bilties into SAP MIRO, producing data entry errors, GST mismatches, and carrier disputes.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Examining the core friction points in current operations. Notice the process bottlenecks that create revenue leakage.
bullets: Disconnected data silos across regional plants and commercial entities.
High variance between physical operations and digital ledger postings.
Heavy developer dependency on proprietary legacy custom code.

cards.title: Clean Core Solution Architecture
cards.botDialogue: Here is our decoupled Clean Core architecture. Notice how SAP BTP handles high-velocity transactions while keeping S/4HANA untouched.

cards.title: End-to-End Execution Flow
cards.botDialogue: Notice our 3-step automated flow. From transaction intake to verified settlement, the process is fast and auditable.

steps.title: Step 1: S/4HANA Order Distribution & Fleet Dispatch - Commercial Auditor distributes SAP Sales Orders to transporters; drivers receive digital dispatch passes with origin gross/tare weighment.
steps.desc: Step 1: S/4HANA Order Distribution & Fleet Dispatch - Commercial Auditor distributes SAP Sales Orders to transporters; drivers receive digital dispatch passes with origin gross/tare weighment.

steps.title: Step 2: Dual Weighbridge Telemetry & Yard Offload - Trucks offload at customer siding; destination weighbridge captures net payload and verifies tolerance threshold automatically.
steps.desc: Step 2: Dual Weighbridge Telemetry & Yard Offload - Trucks offload at customer siding; destination weighbridge captures net payload and verifies tolerance threshold automatically.

steps.title: Step 3: AI Decision OCR & Automated MIRO Settlement - Driver uploads stamped bilty; AI validates receiver stamp and matches weights, triggering automated SAP MIRO invoice posting.
steps.desc: Step 3: AI Decision OCR & Automated MIRO Settlement - Driver uploads stamped bilty; AI validates receiver stamp and matches weights, triggering automated SAP MIRO invoice posting.
